cases.case_label: De novo Alu in exon V of F9 (Glu96)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 5'-truncated (by 38 bp) Alu of the youngest human-specific subfamily inserted in exon V interrupts the reading frame at Glu96, creating a stop codon within the inserted sequence.
cases.quote: The element interrupts the reading frame of the mature factor IX at glutamic acid 96 resulting in a stop codon within the inserted sequence.
